Definition: from G4160; action, i.e. performance (of the law):--deed.
BiblicalUsage: Poiesis is action, the doing of the law. It stands once, in James 1:25: the man who looks into the perfect law of liberty and continues therein, being not a forgetful hearer but a doer of the work, shall be blessed in his deed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the blessing is not in the hearing but in the doing.
